name: job_kill
description: Cancel a pending user job by its `job_id` when the human no longer needs to do it. Completed or already-cancelled jobs cannot be killed (job_kill reports the current status). In practice the user cancels a job from its card; this tool is the explicit recall path.

job_id.description: The job id returned by request_user_job (e.g. ujob_...).

prompt: job_kill: cancel a pending user job by `job_id` if the human no longer needs to do it. Completed or already-cancelled jobs cannot be killed.
